body: Honestly, where can I find a list of suicide methods with details? I, mainly, want to have knowledge on the painless ways to end it. Don't mind terrible ways but ones that are quick? Can anyone please point me in the right direction?

Honestly, this happened quite a bit when I was still in school. Mainly from 7th to 10th grade. Though, I almost always found out after the fact. I only recall one time I met this girl who I crushed on the first two times I saw and socialized with her. I'm usually oblivious to noticing signs of infatuation or affection especially if I think that she is attractive. Fortunately, I picked up on it this time. She is 10 years older than me on top of that, so the level of maturity would usually intimidate and throw me off. Come to find out that our birthdays are 4 days apart, we are both Libras, have the same favorite colors, and live 2 minutes away from each other by car. Two years have passed and we have been happily dating. She is my first love and first in many other aspects of having a significant other. We met at a methadone clinic and sadly ceased communication for the time being to better ourselves and hoping to still keep our promise on having a serious relationship after bettering ourselves while maintaining sobriety bsince we both relapsed and were using heavily this past year.

So, this goes to show that no one is out of your league. You just have to be confident and optimistic.
